features: Add a cyberpunk aqua marquee in the open header area that reads the existing cross-device R2 memo JSON and continuously surfaces recent field notes on the main page.
The marquee shows recent memo date/time, symbol, and note text, so watched assets and recorded price/target notes are visible without opening the memo drawer.
Marquee data refreshes from the same /api/memos source on initial page load and immediately after memo save, update, or delete; no new R2 object or Worker endpoint is required.
No chart, CCI, probability, market filter, research, memo storage/editing behavior, or unrelated engine logic is changed.
